items.question: How many days of fully paid annual leave is a UAE private sector employee entitled to after completing one year of service under the UAE Labour Law?
items.gold: 30 days of fully paid annual leave.
items.fact: Annual leave entitlement after one year: 30 fully paid days.

items.question: How many days of fully-paid maternity leave is a female worker in the UAE private sector entitled to under the UAE Labour Law?
items.gold: 45 days will be fully-paid leave (within a 60-day total maternity leave).
items.fact: Maternity leave: 45 of 60 days fully paid.
